name: Grumbling
overview: Scripture condemns grumbling as a harmful attitude that reflects distrust and discontent against God and His provision, as seen in the Israelites' murmurings recorded in Exodus 16:7 and Numbers 14:27. Believers are exhorted in Philippians 2:14-15 to do all things without complaining, so they may live blamelessly and shine as lights in a corrupt world. Additionally, James 5:9 warns against holding grudges or grievances among brethren, highlighting the spiritual danger of such attitudes and the imminent judgment awaiting those who harbor them.
